AddonsRequest.description: gmod cannot enumerate its own addons, so the native module reads ~/gserv/repos and reports it here on every connect.

games.description: Game content the server has mounted, reported on every connect.

title.description: Absent when the engine has no name for it; the folder is the fallback.

repos.description: One row per addon root. Absent when the server has no native module.

branch.description: branch name, or a short sha when HEAD is detached

remote.description: origin remote url, empty when there is none

sub.description: addon root inside the repo, "." when the repo itself is the addon

wsid.description: workshop id from .workshopid, empty when there is none
